display_long_description:
Turn your space into a language-practicing playground with Spatial Lingo—a cutting-edge showcase app for Meta Quest, now open source and built for developers! Transform your environment into an interactive classroom, where learning new vocabulary is intuitive and memorable. Spatial Lingo overlays translated words onto real-world objects using advanced AI and the Passthrough Camera API.

Whether you’re at home, in the office, or out exploring, Spatial Lingo identifies objects around you and instantly displays their names in your chosen language. A playful 3D companion guides you, offering encouragement and feedback as you practice speaking. The app listens to your voice, evaluates your responses, and helps you master pronunciation and sentence structure in real time.

Key Features:

- Immersive Language Practice: Learn by exploring your real environment.
- AI-Powered Object Recognition: Instantly identifies and translates everyday objects.
- Interactive 3D Companion: Get guidance and feedback from a friendly character.
- Voice Recognition & Evaluation: Practice speaking and get instant feedback.
- Open Source: Dive into the code, contribute, or build your own experiences.

Spatial Lingo demonstrates what’s possible with mixed reality and AI on Meta Quest.

Download the app to get inspired, explore the open source implementation, and use it as a foundation for your own innovative projects.

Link to open source project: https://github.com/oculus-samples/Unity-SpatialLingo
